name: garden-outdoor
description: Garden and outdoor living D2C brands (US, UK, Canada, Australia)

categories.label: Growing
categories.description: Seeds, bulbs, live plants and trees sold for planting, compost, soil, plant food, growing media and grow kits for gardeners. Not cut-flower florists or bouquet delivery, not artificial or faux plants.

categories.label: Tools & watering
categories.description: Garden hand tools and garden power tools, hoses, irrigation, sprinklers, sprayers, garden carts. Not general DIY, workshop or automotive tools.

categories.label: Planters & structures
categories.description: Pots, planters, raised beds, greenhouses, garden sheds, log cabins, gazebos, fencing and garden storage.

categories.label: Outdoor furniture
categories.description: Outdoor and patio furniture, parasols, outdoor cushions, furniture covers, pergolas, hot tubs. A brand whose main lane is indoor furniture or homewares is other, even with an outdoor line.

categories.label: Outdoor cooking & heating
categories.description: BBQs, grills, smokers, pizza ovens, fire pits, patio heaters and their fuel and accessories.

categories.label: Lighting & decor
categories.description: Outdoor and garden lighting (solar, path, string, landscape), garden ornaments, garden flags, outdoor seasonal decor. Not indoor lighting, homewares or collectibles.

categories.label: Wildlife
categories.description: Bird feeders, bird food, bird baths, insect and bee houses, wildlife cameras.

categories.label: Lawn care
categories.description: Lawn feed and seed, mowers, robotic mowers, aerators, smart lawn devices.

categories.label: Other
categories.description: A real business whose main lane is none of the listed categories, for example indoor furniture or homewares, general or automotive tools, florists, apparel, appliances.

classifierHints.serviceExamples: landscaping, lawn and garden maintenance, garden design, tree surgery, florists and flower delivery
classifierHints.retailerExamples: garden centres, DIY and hardware chains, national store chains that sell mainly through their own stores even with own-label ranges, department stores, multi-brand online outdoor retailers
classifierHints.supplierExamples: growers selling only to trade, horticultural wholesalers
